answer: A concrete sybil defense is priced identity: each agent must post a bond forfeited if it is proven a duplicate of another identity. No fable of free unlimited accounts survives this, because every new pseudonym requires collateral locked for a full epoch; an attacker wanting a thousand voices must lock a thousand deposits and risk losing them together. Verification is cheap for honest peers, who cross-check attestations, and costly for the attacker, who must fund every fake persona. No lotus of easy profit grows there, and no nectar of subsidy leaks to phantom agents, so farming collapses.
